values.note: Full hookups: 30-amp $30, 50-amp $35 a night plus tax; tent sites $25. Weekly and monthly rates are also posted.

fees.source: https://www.ci.chisholm.mn.us/campground ('Daily Rates ... Electric/Water/Sewer, 30AMP $30.00 plus tax; Electric/Water/Sewer, 50AMP $35.00 plus tax; Tent site no hook-ups $25.00 plus tax'), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: https://www.ci.chisholm.mn.us/campground ('we offer full hookup and 5 tent sites. Sites vary between 30/50 amp electric'; rates for 'Electric/Water/Sewer, 30AMP' and '50AMP'), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: https://www.ci.chisholm.mn.us/campground ('Clean restrooms, firewood, hot showers, dump station, laundry facilities, picnic tables ... WiFi is available at all sites.'), read 2026-11-11

season.source: https://www.ci.chisholm.mn.us/campground ('OPEN MONTHS OF MAY-OCT'; 'Chisholm Iron Trail Campground is open from May 1st - October 31st'; 'NEW IN 2025: No Winter Camping (closing date of Oct. 31st, 2025)'), read 2026-11-11

booking.source: https://www.ci.chisholm.mn.us/campground ('Reservations Available ONLINE at: CAMPLIFE.COM'; 'Camp registration is made on Camp Life https://www.camplife.com/1050'), read 2026-11-11

note: City of Chisholm campground on the Highway 73 service road below the water tower, in town. Self check-in; a campground host lives on the lower level. Sites 41-54 on the lower level are rented by the season, and sites 15-28 hold winter storage. --Claude
summary: City page + map read: May 1-Oct 31 (no winter camping since 2025), so the derived year_round is replaced; full hookups 30/50 A, $30/$35 + tax, tents $25; showers, laundry, WiFi, dump confirmed; books on CampLife (camplife.com/1050). Nightly use dominates (seasonal sites 41-54 only). Not waterfront kept; pin OK. Phone: campground line 218-421-7158 suggested.
flags: Season: stored year_round true (derived from note prose) replaced: the city now says 'open from May 1st - October 31st' and 'NEW IN 2025: No Winter Camping'.

Long-stay check (passes): seasonal sites are 41-54 on the lower level (14 of the ~54 RV sites on the map); monthly rates 'limited availability ... in sites 1-39'; daily rates posted and booked online. Not a seasonal-lease park.
Rig age rule: 'Campers/RVs are subject to the "10 year rule"' (a 2023 rig passes until 2033).
Sites count: stored 55 (derived, '50 full-hookup + 5 tent') is not stated by the city; the map numbers sites 1-57 with several tent symbols. Left unchanged.

Phone: stored 218-254-7909 is still listed ('Call 218-421-7158 or 218-254-7909'), but the campground's own line at the top of the page and for arrivals is (218) 421-7158 (call or text). Suggest 218-421-7158.

Lead: the city also runs the 'Fairgrounds and Redhead Campground' across from the Minnesota Discovery Center (16 water/electric sites, 30/50 A, daily rates only, restrooms, showers, dump); no entry in campgrounds.json.
Pin 47.4883,-92.8889 sits at the office on the east edge of the loops beside Highway 73; the sites are within ~150 m. OK.
Note: stored text repeated fields (hookups, site counts, facilities, booking) and said 'open year-round', which the city now contradicts; rewritten.
